|gr1= Program Flow

|descr= Assign a user friendly name to the [[Script Handle|VM script]] this command is executed from.
{{Feature|important|Once a name is assigned, it cannot be changed.}}

|s1= [[scriptName]] name

|p1= name: [[String]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>scriptName "leetScript.sqf";</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>scriptName format ["%1ARTY\data\scripts\ARTY_sadarmDeploy.sqf (_this: %1)", _this];</sqf>

|seealso= [[spawn]] [[execVM]] [[scriptDone]]
}}

{{Note
|user= PhilippRauch
|timestamp= 20090613173900
|text= [[scriptName]] is good when you want to load the handle of some spawn or call with some name:
<sqf>
example_scripthandle = 0 spawn {
	scriptName "Example";
	systemChat str example_scripthandle; // System: Example
}
</sqf>
}}
